newsitem.title: TURKEY: TURKISH AIRLINES, AIR FRANCE IN CARGO COOPERATION.
newsitem.headline: TURKISH AIRLINES, AIR FRANCE IN CARGO COOPERATION.

text.p: Turkish Airlines (THY) will cooperate with Air France Cargo to run scheduled cargo flights from Turkey to North America, THY said in a statement.

It said three flights a week would be arranged jointly by the two national carriers from September 18 with B-727 cargo aircraft flying to Paris from Istanbul and B-747s to nine major airports in North America from Paris.
"For Turkish Airlines, this is the first such cooperation between two national airlines to operate scheduled cargo flights," said a THY senior cargo official.
He said THY cooperated with several foreign airlines in cargo flights, but not on a scheduled basis.
Weekly cargo flights were planned to be raised to five after October 26 due to an expected increase in demand from Turkish exporters in the winter season, THY said.
It said additional cargo flights could also be arranged to 79 destinations in North America from the major airports.
Freight and mail cargo carried by the THY totalled 89,000 tonnes in 1995. It has three cargo jets in its fleet of 63 aircrafts.
